subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: After the four stale pin assertions are repaired and exact-head checks pass, should these verified token-, registry-, CodeQL-, and Codex-bearing action upgrades land as one grouped update or be split for separate security review?
rationale: Source inspection verifies official immutable releases and compatible interfaces, but the protected security label and privileged workflow contexts reserve acceptance of the grouped supply-chain change for a human owner.

options.title: Repair and approve the group
options.body: Keep the grouped update, synchronize all pin contracts, and approve it after exact-head workflow and security validation passes.

options.title: Split privileged upgrades
options.body: Separate the Codex, token, registry, and security-scanning actions into smaller updates for individual review.

recommendation.title: Repair and approve the group
recommendation.body: Keep the grouped update, synchronize all pin contracts, and approve it after exact-head workflow and security validation passes.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest sampled ownership history across the central workflows and the most recent CI guard maintenance.
